name: Interis
tagline: Death is certain. Your paperwork shouldn't be a mystery too.
positioning: Interis is the case-management platform for multi-location funeral groups — every service, certificate, and grieving family in one morbidly efficient system.

hero.h1: Run 40 funeral homes without losing your soul (or a body).
hero.sub: Interis is the enterprise operating system for funeral groups. Track every case, file every certificate on time, and stop coordinating families over sticky notes and a shared inbox from 2011.

features.title: One case, one source of truth
features.description: Every service — arrangement, embalming, transport, cremation, burial — lives on a single timeline your whole chain can see. No more calling three branches to find one urn.

features.title: Certificate autopilot
features.description: Death certificates, permits, and disposition filings pre-filled from case data and routed to the right county before the deadline you always forget exists.

features.title: Compliance that doesn't flinch
features.description: State-by-state rules, FTC price-list requirements, and audit trails baked in. When the regulator visits, you hand them a report instead of a shrug.

features.title: Inventory that isn't a spreadsheet
features.description: Caskets, urns, and rental fleet tracked across every location in real time. Know what's in the showroom before you promise it to a family.

features.title: Family comms, minus the chaos
features.description: Every text, email, and update logged against the case. Grieving families get answers; your staff stops screenshotting messages to each other.

features.title: Numbers your CFO respects
features.description: Case volume, revenue per service, at-need vs. pre-need mix, and margin by location — dashboards that survive a board meeting.

testimonials.quote: We merged four family businesses and inherited four ways of doing everything. Interis gave us one. Our directors stopped arguing about spreadsheets and went back to arguing about parking.
testimonials.name: Marguerite Aldy

testimonials.quote: The certificate deadlines used to keep me up at night. Now the platform nags people so I don't have to. I've reclaimed both my evenings and my sense of humor.
testimonials.name: Desmond Okafor

testimonials.quote: Onboarding a new location used to take six weeks and a prayer. With Interis it took a long weekend. The audit last quarter was, frankly, boring — which is the highest compliment I can give.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkataraman

pricing.blurb: For single-location homes that finally want to retire the filing cabinet.
For growing groups that need every branch reading from the same page.
For national chains and acquirers folding new homes in constantly.

homepage.footerBlurb: Interis keeps funeral groups organized, compliant, and quietly profitable — so your people can focus on families instead of forms.
